match_tolerance_policy.content: AP Three-Way Match Tolerance Policy v4.2. Price variance tolerance: lesser of 2% or $50 per invoice. Quantity variance tolerance: 0% for goods (exact match required); service POs validated against not-to-exceed amount. Any invoice exceeding tolerance is flagged as a discrepancy and held for AP analyst review. Approval requires all three documents present and within tolerance.

tools.name: query_ap_invoice_queue
tools.description: Read the pending vendor invoices in the AP Invoice Queue, including invoice numbers, vendors, amounts, quantities, and PO references.

tools.name: retrieve_purchase_orders
tools.description: Retrieve the open purchase orders to match against invoices, including ordered quantities, unit prices, and approved totals.

tools.name: retrieve_receiving_reports
tools.description: Retrieve the receiving dock reports to confirm what was actually delivered against each purchase order.

tools.name: run_three_way_match_check
tools.description: Compare each invoice against its purchase order and receiving report, applying the tolerance policy to determine matches and flag discrepancies.

tools.name: draft_match_results_summary
tools.description: Prepare a match-results summary listing each invoice, its match status, any flagged discrepancies, and a recommended disposition for the user's approval.

tools.name: set_invoice_status_approved
tools.description: Update an invoice's status to Approved in the AP ledger, releasing it into the payment pipeline.

tools.name: email_vendor_payment_notice
tools.description: Send an email to a vendor confirming that their invoice has been matched and approved for payment.

tools.name: post_match_results_to_ap_channel
tools.description: Post the match results and any discrepancy alerts to the #ap-invoices Slack channel, notifying the AP team.

tools.name: lookup_ap_team_directory
tools.description: Look up AP team members, their contact details, and the AP notification channel.

tools.name: read_tolerance_policy_manual
tools.description: Read the AP three-way match tolerance policy manual for reference on variance thresholds and approval requirements.

tools.name: lookup_vendor_contacts
tools.description: Look up vendor accounts-receivable contact email addresses for reference.
